result types\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\nenum CheckStatus {\n    Pass,\n    Warn,\n    Fail,\n}\n\nstruct CheckResult {\n    name: String,\n    status: CheckStatus,\n    message: String,\n    /// Extra lines printed indented below the main line.\n    detail: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl CheckResult {\n    fn pass(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Pass,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn warn(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Warn,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn fail(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Fail,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn with_detail(mut self, lines: Vec<String>) -> Self {\n        self.detail = lines;\n        self\n    }\n    fn display(&self) -> String {\n        let label = match self.status {\n            CheckStatus::Pass => \"PASS\",\n            CheckStatus::Warn => \"WARN\",\n            CheckStatus::Fail => \"FAIL\",\n        };\n        format!(\"[{label}]  {:<28}  {}\", self.name, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Doctor: individual check functions\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfn doctor_check_config(workspace: &Path) -> CheckResult {\n    match ConfigLoader::load_resolved(workspace, CliOverrides::default()) {\n        Ok(_) => CheckResult::pass(\"Config\", \"valid\"),\n        Err(e) => CheckResult::fail(\"Config\", format!(\"{e:#}\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_workspace(workspace: &Path) -> CheckResult {\n    if !workspace.exists() {\n        return CheckResult::fail(\n            \"Workspace\",\n            format!(\"directory not found: {}\", workspace.display()),\n        );\n    }\n    if !workspace.is_dir() {\n        return CheckResult::fail(\n            \"Workspace\",\n            format!(\"not a directory: {}\", workspace.display()),\n        );\n    }\n    if std::fs::read_dir(workspace).is_err() {\n        return CheckResult::fail(\"Workspace\", \"not readable\");\n    }\n    let beads_dir = workspace.join(\".beads\");\n    if !beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        return CheckResult::fail(\n            \"Workspace\",\n            format!(\".beads/ missing in {}\", workspace.display()),\n        );\n    }\n    // Probe write access.\n    let probe = workspace.join(\".needle_doctor_probe\");\n    match std::fs::write(&probe, b\"\") {\n        Ok(_) => {\n            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&probe);\n            CheckResult::pass(\"Workspace\", workspace.display().to_string())\n        }\n        Err(e) => CheckResult::warn(\"Workspace\", format!(\"not writable: {e}\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_jsonl(beads_dir: &Path) -> CheckResult {\n    let jsonl = beads_dir.join(\"issues.jsonl\");\n    if !jsonl.exists() {\n        return CheckResult::fail(\"JSONL\", \"issues.jsonl not found\");\n    }\n    let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&jsonl) {\n        Ok(c) => c,\n        Err(e) => return CheckResult::fail(\"JSONL\", format!(\"unreadable: {e}\")),\n    };\n    let total = content.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).count();\n    let bad: Vec<usize> = content\n        .lines()\n        .enumerate()\n        .filter(|(_, l)| {\n            !l.trim().is_empty() && serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(l).is_err()\n        })\n        .map(|(i, _)| i + 1)\n        .collect();\n    if bad.is_empty() {\n        CheckResult::pass(\"JSONL\", format!(\"{total} records\"))\n    } else {\n        let examples: Vec<String> = bad.iter().take(5).map(|n| format!(\"line {n}\")).collect();\n        CheckResult::fail(\"JSONL\", format!(\"{} invalid of {total} records\", bad.len()))\n            .with_detail(vec![format!(\"Invalid lines: {}\", examples.join(\", \"))])\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_sqlite(beads_dir: &Path) -> CheckResult {\n    let db = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    if !db.exists() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\"SQLite integrity\", \"no database (JSONL-only mode)\");\n    }\n    match std::process::Command::new(\"sqlite3\")\n        .arg(&db)\n        .arg(\"PRAGMA integrity_check;\")\n        .output()\n    {\n        Err(_) => CheckResult::warn(\"SQLite integrity\", \"sqlite3 not on PATH — skipped\"),\n        Ok(out) if !out.status.success() => {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);\n            CheckResult::fail(\n                \"SQLite integrity\",\n                format!(\"sqlite3 error: {}\", stderr.trim()),\n            )\n        }\n        Ok(out) => {\n            let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);\n            let trimmed = stdout.trim();\n            if trimmed == \"ok\" {\n                CheckResult::pass(\"SQLite integrity\", \"ok\")\n            } else {\n                let first = trimmed.lines().next().unwrap_or(trimmed);\n                CheckResult::fail(\"SQLite integrity\", format!(\"corrupt: {first}\")).with_detail(\n                    trimmed\n                        .lines()\n                        .skip(1)\n                        .take(10)\n                        .map(str::to_owned)\n                        .collect(),\n                )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_lock_files(beads_dir: &Path, lock_ttl_secs: u64, repair: bool) -> CheckResult {\n    let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(beads_dir) {\n        Ok(e) => e,\n        Err(e) => return CheckResult::warn(\"Lock files\", format!(\"cannot read .beads/: {e}\")),\n    };\n    let ttl = std::time::Duration::from_secs(lock_ttl_secs);\n    let now = std::time::SystemTime::now();\n    let mut total = 0usize;\n    let mut stale: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();\n    for entry in entries.flatten() {\n        let path = entry.path();\n        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"lock\") {\n            continue;\n        }\n        total += 1;\n        if let Ok(meta) = std::fs::metadata(&path) {\n            if let Ok(modified) = meta.modified() {\n                if now.duration_since(modified).unwrap_or_default() > ttl {\n                    stale.push(path);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if stale.is_empty() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\n            \"Lock files\",\n            if total == 0 {\n                \"none\".to_string()\n            } else {\n                format!(\"{total} total, none stale\")\n            },\n        );\n    }\n    if repair {\n        let mut removed = 0usize;\n        let mut failed_names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        for p in &stale {\n            match std::fs::remove_file(p) {\n                Ok(_) => removed += 1,\n                Err(_) => failed_names.push(p.display().to_string()),\n            }\n        }\n        if failed_names.is_empty() {\n            CheckResult::pass(\"Lock files\", format!(\"removed {removed} stale lock(s)\"))\n        } else {\n            CheckResult::warn(\n                \"Lock files\",\n                format!(\"removed {removed}, failed to remove {}\", failed_names.len()),\n            )\n            .with_detail(failed_names)\n        }\n    } else {\n        let names: Vec<String> = stale\n            .iter()\n            .map(|p| {\n                p.file_name()\n                    .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())\n                    .unwrap_or_default()\n            })\n            .collect();\n        CheckResult::warn(\n            \"Lock files\",\n            format!(\"{} stale of {total} (TTL {lock_ttl_secs}s)\", stale.len()),\n        )\n        .with_detail(names)\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_bead_store(\n    workspace: &Path,\n    beads_dir: &Path,\n    repair: bool,\n) -> Result<CheckResult> {\n    if !beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        return Ok(CheckResult::pass(\"Bead store\", \"skipped (no .beads/)\"));\n    }\n    // Worker dispatch prefers `bf` (atomic server-selected claiming) but\n    // falls back to `br` for older installs, so check for either — a\n    // machine with only one of the two on PATH should not FAIL here.\n    let store: Box<dyn BeadStore> =\n        match BfCliBeadStore::discover(workspace.to_path_buf(), None, None, None) {\n            Ok(s) => Box::new(s),\n            Err(bf_err) => match BrCliBeadStore::discover(workspace.to_path_buf()) {\n                Ok(s) => Box::new(s),\n                Err(br_err) => {\n                    return Ok(CheckResult::fail(\n                        \"Bead store\",\n                        format!(\"no bead store CLI found (bf: {bf_err}; br: {br_err})\"),\n                    ))\n                }\n            },\n        };\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    if repair {\n        match rt.block_on(store.doctor_repair()) {\n            Err(e) => Ok(CheckResult::fail(\n                \"Bead store\",\n                format!(\"repair failed: {e}\"),\n            )),\n            Ok(report) if report.warnings.is_empty() && report.fixed.is_empty() => {\n                Ok(CheckResult::pass(\"Bead store\", \"ok (no issues found)\"))\n            }\n            Ok(report) => {\n                let mut detail = Vec::new();\n                for w in &report.warnings {\n                    detail.push(format!(\"warn: {w}\"));\n                }\n                for f in &report.fixed {\n                    detail.push(format!(\"fixed: {f}\"));\n                }\n                Ok(\n                    CheckResult::pass(\"Bead store\", format!(\"{} fixed\", report.fixed.len()))\n                        .with_detail(detail),\n                )\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        match rt.block_on(store.doctor_check()) {\n            Err(e) => Ok(CheckResult::fail(\"Bead store\", format!(\"{e}\"))),\n            Ok(report) if report.warnings.is_empty() => Ok(CheckResult::pass(\"Bead store\", \"ok\")),\n            Ok(report) => Ok(CheckResult::warn(\n                \"Bead store\",\n                format!(\"{} warning(s)\", report.warnings.len()),\n            )\n            .with_detail(report.warnings)),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_registry(needle_home: &Path, repair: bool) -> CheckResult {\n    let registry = Registry::default_location(needle_home);\n    match registry.list() {\n        Err(e) => CheckResult::fail(\"Worker registry\", format!(\"{e}\")),\n        Ok(workers) => {\n            let stale: Vec<&WorkerEntry> =\n                workers.iter().filter(|w| !is_pid_alive(w.pid)).collect();\n            if stale.is_empty() {\n                CheckResult::pass(\n                    \"Worker registry\",\n                    if },\n                )\n            } else {\n                let names: Vec<String> = stale\n                    .iter()\n                    .map(|w| format!(\"{}(pid={})\", w.id, w.pid))\n                    .collect();\n                if repair {\n                    let mut removed = 0usize;\n                    let mut failed = 0usize;\n                    for w in &stale {\n                        match registry.deregister(&w.id) {\n                            Ok(_) => removed += 1,\n                            Err(_) => failed += 1,\n                        }\n                    }\n worker(s)\"),\n                        )\n                    } else {\n                        CheckResult::warn(\n                            \"Worker registry\",\n                            format!(\"deregistered {removed}, failed {failed}\"),\n                        )\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    CheckResult::warn(\n                        \"Worker registry\",\n                        format!(\"{} stale of {}\", stale.len(), workers.len()),\n                    )\n                    .with_detail(names)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_heartbeat_dir(heartbeat_dir: &Path, repair: bool) -> CheckResult {\n    if !heartbeat_dir.exists() {\n        if repair {\n            match CheckResult::pass(\"Heartbeat dir\", \"writable\")\n        }\n        Err(e) => CheckResult::fail(\"Heartbeat dir\", format!(\"not writable: {e}\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_heartbeats(heartbeat_dir: &Path, ttl_secs: u64, repair: bool) -> CheckResult {\n    if !heartbeat_dir.is_dir() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\"Heartbeat files\", \"no heartbeat {e}\")),\n    };\n    let mut total = 0usize;\n    let mut stale_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();\n    for entry in entries.flatten() {\n        let path = entry.path();\n        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"json\") {\n            continue;\n        }\n        total += 1;\n        let is_stale = if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n            if let Ok(hb) = serde_json::from_str::<HeartbeatData>(&content) {\n                let age = Utc::now()\n                    .signed_duration_since(hb.last_heartbeat)\n                    .num_seconds();\n                age > ttl_secs as i64\n            } else if let Ok(raw) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&content) {\n                raw.get(\"pid\")\n                    .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())\n                    .map(|pid| !is_pid_alive(pid as u32))\n                    .unwrap_or(true)\n            } else {\n                true\n            }\n        } else {\n            true\n        };\n        if is_stale {\n            stale_paths.push(path);\n        }\n    }\n    if stale_paths.is_empty() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\"Heartbeat files\", format!(\"{total} file(s), none stale\"));\n    }\n    if repair {\n        let mut removed = 0usize;\n        let mut failed = 0usize;\n        for p in &stale_paths {\n            match std::fs::remove_file(p) {\n                Ok(_) => removed += 1,\n                Err(_) => failed += 1,\n            }\n        }\n        if failed == 0 {\n            CheckResult::pass(\n                \"Heartbeat files\",\n                format!(\"removed {removed} stale of {total}\"),\n            )\n        } else {\n            CheckResult::warn(\n                \"Heartbeat files\",\n                format!(\"removed {removed}, failed {failed}\"),\n            )\n        }\n    } else {\n        CheckResult::warn(\n            \"Heartbeat files\",\n            format!(\"{} stale of {total}\", stale_paths.len()),\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_peers(heartbeat_dir: &Path, ttl_secs: u64) -> CheckResult {\n    let ttl = std::time::Duration::from_secs(ttl_secs);\n    let heartbeats = match HealthMonitor::read_all_heartbeats(heartbeat_dir) {\n        Ok(hbs) => hbs,\n        Err(e) => return CheckResult::warn(\"Peers\", format!(\"cannot read heartbeats: {e}\")),\n    };\n    if heartbeats.is_empty() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\"Peers\", \"no workers running\");\n    }\n    let (active, stale): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) = heartbeats\n        .iter()\n        .partition(|hb| !HealthMonitor::is_stale(hb, ttl));\n    let msg = format!(\"{} active, {} stale\", active.len(), stale.len());\n    let mut detail: Vec<String> = active\n        .iter()\n        .map(|hb| {\n            let bead = hb\n                .current_bead\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|b| b.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| \"–\".to_string());\n            format!(\n                \"{} pid={} state={:?} bead={}\",\n                hb.worker_id, hb.pid, hb.state, bead\n            )\n        })\n        .collect();\n    for hb in &stale {\n        detail.push(format!(\n            \"[stale] {} pid={} last={}\",\n            hb.worker_id, hb.pid, hb.last_heartbeat\n        ));\n    }\n    CheckResult::pass(\"Peers\", msg).with_detail(detail)\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_agent_binary(config: &Config) -> CheckResult {\n    let agent = &config.agent.default;\n    // Worker dispatch prefers `bf` (atomic server-selected claiming) but\n    // falls back to `br` for older installs, so accept either being on\n    // PATH rather than hard-requiring `br`.\n    let bead_cli = if which::which(\"bf\").is_ok() {\n        Some(\"bf\")\n    } else if which::which(\"br\").is_ok() {\n        Some(\"br\")\n    } else {\n        None\n    };\n    let agent_ok = which::which(agent).is_ok();\n    match (bead_cli, agent_ok) {\n        (Some(cli), true) => CheckResult::pass(\"Agent binary\", format!(\"{cli} + {agent} on PATH\")),\n        (None, _) => CheckResult::fail(\n            \"Agent binary\",\n            \"no bead store CLI found on PATH (checked bf, br)\",\n        ),\n        (Some(cli), false) => CheckResult::warn(\n            \"Agent binary\",\n            format!(\"{cli} found but {agent} not found on PATH — workers cannot dispatch\"),\n        ),\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_adapter_transforms(config: &Config) -> CheckResult {\n    match dispatch::load_adapters(&config.agent.adapters_dir, &dispatch::builtin_adapters()) {\n        Err(e) => CheckResult::fail(\"Adapter transforms\", format!(\"cannot load adapters: {e}\")),\n        Ok(adapters) => {\n            let mut missing: Vec<String> = adapters\n                .values()\n                .filter_map(|a| a.output_transform.as_deref())\n                .filter(|bin| which::which(bin).is_err())\n                .map(str::to_owned)\n                .collect();\n            missing.sort();\n            missing.dedup();\n            if missing.is_empty() {\n                CheckResult::pass(\"Adapter transforms\", \"ok\")\n            } else {\n                CheckResult::warn(\n                    \"Adapter transforms\",\n                    format!(\"{} binary/binaries not on PATH\", missing.len()),\n                )\n                .with_detail(missing)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_disk_space(path: &Path) -> CheckResult {\n    // df --block-size=1M --output=avail <path> prints a header + one value.\n    let output = std::process::Command::new(\"df\")\n        .args([\"--block-size=1M\", \"--output=avail\"])\n        .arg(path)\n        .output();\n    match output {\n        Err(_) => CheckResult::warn(\"Disk space\", \"df not available — skipped\"),\n        Ok(out) if !out.status.success() => CheckResult::warn(\"Disk space\", \"df command failed\"),\n        Ok(out) => {\n            let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);\n            let avail_mb = stdout\n                .lines()\n                .nth(1)\n                .and_then(|l| l.trim().parse::<u64>().ok())\n                .unwrap_or(0);\n            if avail_mb < 100 {\n                CheckResult::fail(\n                    \"Disk space\",\n                    format!(\"{avail_mb} MB available — critically low\"),\n                )\n            } else if avail_mb < 500 {\n                CheckResult::warn(\"Disk space\", format!(\"{avail_mb} MB available — low\"))\n            } else {\n                CheckResult::pass(\"Disk space\", format!(\"{avail_mb} MB available\"))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn doctor_check_telemetry_logs(config: &Config, needle_home: &Path, repair: bool) -> CheckResult {\n    let log_dir = config\n        .telemetry\n        .file_sink\n        .log_dir\n        .clone()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| needle_home.join(\"logs\"));\n    if !log_dir.is_dir() {\n        return CheckResult::pass(\"Telemetry logs\", \"no log directory yet\");\n    }\n    let retention_days = config.telemetry.file_sink.retention_days;\n    let mut total = 0u64;\n    let mut expired = 0u64;\n    let cutoff = if retention_days > 0 {\n        Some(\n            std::time::SystemTime::now()\n                - std::time::Duration::from_secs(u64::from(retention_days) * 86400),\n        )\n    } else {\n        None\n    };\n    if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&log_dir) {\n        for entry in entries.flatten() {\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n            total += 1;\n            if let Some(cutoff) = cutoff {\n                if let Ok(meta) = std::fs::metadata(&path) {\n                    if let Ok(modified) = meta.modified() {\n                        if modified < cutoff {\n                            expired += 1;\n                            if repair {\n                                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if expired == 0 {\n        CheckResult::pass(\"Telemetry logs\", format!(\"{total} file(s)\"))\n    } else if repair {\n        CheckResult::pass(\n            \"Telemetry logs\",\n            format!(\"removed {expired} expired of {total} (retention: {retention_days}d)\"),\n        )\n    } else {\n        CheckResult::warn(\n            \"Telemetry logs\",\n            format!(\"{expired} expired of {total} (retention: {retention_days}d) — use --repair to clean\"),\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// `needle doctor` — comprehensive system health check\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle doctor` — check system health and optionally repair.\nfn cmd_doctor(repair: bool, workspace: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let workspace_root = workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| config.workspace.default.clone());\n    let beads_dir = workspace_root.join(\".beads\");\n    let heartbeat_dir = needle_home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n\n    let width = 60;\n    println!(\"NEEDLE Doctor\");\n    println!(\"{}\", \"─\".repeat(width));\n\n    let mut results: Vec<CheckResult> = Vec::new();\n\n    // Config\n    results.push(doctor_check_config(&workspace_root));\n\n    // Workspace accessibility + .beads/ presence\n    results.push(doctor_check_workspace(&workspace_root));\n\n    // JSONL consistency\n    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        results.push(doctor_check_jsonl(&beads_dir));\n    }\n\n    // SQLite integrity (raw PRAGMA — independent of br)\n    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        results.push(doctor_check_sqlite(&beads_dir));\n    }\n\n    // Stale lock files\n    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        results.push(doctor_check_lock_files(\n            &beads_dir,\n            config.strands.mend.lock_ttl_secs,\n            repair,\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Bead store connectivity (br doctor)\n    results.push(doctor_check_bead_store(\n        &workspace_root,\n        &beads_dir,\n        repair,\n    )?);\n\n    // Worker registry\n    results.push(doctor_check_registry(&needle_home, repair));\n\n    // Heartbeat directory permissions\n    results.push(doctor_check_heartbeat_dir(&heartbeat_dir, repair));\n\n    // Heartbeat file staleness\n    results.push(doctor_check_heartbeats(\n        &heartbeat_dir,\n        config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs,\n        repair,\n    ));\n\n    // Peer status\n    results.push(doctor_check_peers(\n        &heartbeat_dir,\n        config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs,\n    ));\n\n    // Agent binary availability\n    results.push(doctor_check_agent_binary(&config));\n\n    // Adapter transform binaries\n    results.push(doctor_check_adapter_transforms(&config));\n\n    // Disk space\n    results.push(doctor_check_disk_space(&workspace_root));\n\n    // Telemetry logs\n    results.push(doctor_check_telemetry_logs(&config, &needle_home, repair));\n\n    // Print results.\n    for r in &results {\n        println!(\"{}\", r.display());\n        for line in &r.detail {\n            println!(\"         └─ {line}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Summary.\n    let fails = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Fail)\n        .count();\n    let warns = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Warn)\n        .count();\n    let passed = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Pass)\n        .count();\n\n    println!(\"{}\", \"─\".repeat(width));\n    if fails == 0 && warns == 0 {\n        println!(\"{passed} check(s) passed.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"{passed} passed, {warns} warning(s), {fails} failure(s).\");\n        if !repair && (fails > 0 || warns > 0) {\n            println!(\"Run `needle doctor --repair` to attempt automatic fixes.\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Logs command\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle logs` — view and query telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_logs(\n    follow: bool,\n    filter: Vec<String>,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let log_dir = config\n        .telemetry\n        .file_sink\n        .log_dir\n        .clone()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| needle_home.join(\"logs\"));\n\n    let filter_exprs: Vec<&str> = filter.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();\n    let logs_filter = if filter_exprs.is_empty() {\n        None\n    } else {\n        Some(telemetry::LogsFilter::parse(&filter_exprs)?)\n    };\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n\n    if follow {\n        cmd_logs_follow(&log_dir, logs_filter.as_ref(), since_dt, until_dt, &format)\n    } else {\n        cmd_logs_query(&log_dir, logs_filter.as_ref(), since_dt, until_dt, &format)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Non-follow mode: read all logs and print them.\nfn cmd_logs_query(\n    log_dir: &Path,\n    filter: Option<&telemetry::LogsFilter>,\n    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(log_dir, since, until, filter)?;\n\n    if events.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching events found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let stdout_sink = telemetry::StdoutSink::new(&StdoutSinkConfig {\n        enabled: true,\n        format: crate::config::StdoutFormat::Normal,\n        color: crate::config::ColorMode::Auto,\n    });\n\n    for event in &events {\n        match format {\n            LogFormat::Table | LogFormat::Human => {\n                println!(\"{}\", stdout_sink.format_event(event));\n            }\n            LogFormat::Json | LogFormat::Jsonl => {\n                let line = serde_json::to_string(event).context(\"failed to serialize event\")?;\n                println!(\"{line}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Follow mode: tail new events from all log files.\nfn cmd_logs_follow(\n    log_dir: &Path,\n    filter: Option<&telemetry::LogsFilter>,\n    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n\n    if !log_dir.is_dir() {\n        bail!(\"log directory does not exist: {}\", log_dir.display());\n    }\n\n    let stdout_sink = telemetry::StdoutSink::new(&StdoutSinkConfig {\n        enabled: true,\n        format: crate::config::StdoutFormat::Normal,\n        color: crate::config::ColorMode::Auto,\n    });\n\n    // Build set of known log files and their current sizes (to tail from end).\n    let mut file_positions: std::collections::HashMap<PathBuf, u64> =\n        std::collections::HashMap::new();\n\n    // Print existing events since cutoff first, then tail.\n    if since.is_some() || filter.is_some() {\n        let events = telemetry::read_logs(log_dir, since, until, filter)?;\n        for event in &events {\n            print_log_event(event, format, &stdout_sink);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Record current positions (after initial read).\n    if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(log_dir) {\n        for entry in entries.flatten() {\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) == Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                let len = std::fs::metadata(&path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n                file_positions.insert(path, len);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Polling loop: check for new content every 500ms.\n    loop {\n        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));\n\n        // Check for new files.\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(log_dir) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                file_positions.entry(path).or_insert(0);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Read new content from each file.\n        let positions: Vec<(PathBuf, u64)> = file_positions\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), *v))\n            .collect();\n        for (path, pos) in positions {\n            let current_len = std::fs::metadata(&path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n            if current_len <= pos {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let file = match std::fs::File::open(&path) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            use std::io::Seek;\n            let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);\n            if reader.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(pos)).is_err() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let mut new_pos = pos;\n            let mut line_buf = String::new();\n            while reader.read_line(&mut line_buf).unwrap_or(0) > 0 {\n                let trimmed = line_buf.trim();\n                if !trimmed.is_empty() {\n                    if let Ok(event) = serde_json::from_str::<telemetry::TelemetryEvent>(trimmed) {\n                        let passes = filter.map(|f| f.matches(&event)).unwrap_or(true);\n                        let passes_until = until.map(|u| event.timestamp <= u).unwrap_or(true);\n                        if passes && passes_until {\n                            print_log_event(&event, format, &stdout_sink);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                new_pos += line_buf.len() as u64;\n                line_buf.clear();\n            }\n            file_positions.insert(path, new_pos);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Print a single telemetry event in the requested format.\nfn print_log_event(\n    event: &telemetry::TelemetryEvent,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n    sink: &telemetry::StdoutSink,\n) {\n    match format {\n        LogFormat::Table | LogFormat::Human => println!(\"{}\", sink.format_event(event)),\n        LogFormat::Json | LogFormat::Jsonl => {\n            if let Ok(line) = serde_json::to_string(event) {\n                println!(\"{line}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Status helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Per-worker status information for the status command.\nstruct WorkerStatus {\n    entry: WorkerEntry,\n    heartbeat_state: Option<String>,\n    current_bead: Option<String>,\n    pid_alive: bool,\n    uptime_secs: u64,\n}\n\n/// Check if a process with the given PID is alive.\nfn is_pid_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {\n    // kill(pid, 0) checks if process exists without sending a signal.\n    libc_kill(pid as i32, 0) == 0\n}\n\n/// Minimal binding to kill(2) — only used for PID existence check.\n///\n/// Returns 0 if the process exists, -1 otherwise.\nfn libc_kill(pid: i32, sig: i32) -> i32 {\n    // SAFETY: kill(pid, 0) is a standard POSIX call that checks PID existence.\n    // No signal is actually sent.\n    unsafe {\n        extern \"C\" {\n            fn kill(pid: i32, sig: i32) -> i32;\n        }\n        kill(pid, sig)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Format a duration in seconds to a human-readable string.\nfn format_duration(secs: u64) -> String {\n    if secs < 60 {\n        format!(\"{secs}s\")\n    } else if secs < 3600 {\n        format!(\"{}m{}s\", secs / 60, secs % 60)\n    } else {\n        format!(\"{}h{}m\", secs / 3600, (secs % 3600) / 60)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Idle-strand cooldown helpers\n//    workspace: String,\n    enabled: bool,\n    last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    cooldown_hours: u64,\n    status: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct ReflectStateCli {\n  analyzed: std::collections::HashMap<String, DateTime<Utc>>,\n}\n\n/// Compute a short SHA-256 workspace hash (matches strand implementations).\nfn workspace_hash_cli(workspace: &Path) -> String {\n    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(workspace.display().to_string().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n/// Compute a human-readable cooldown status string for an idle strand.\nfn idle_strand_status(\n    enabled: bool,\n    last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    cooldown_hours: u64,\n    now: DateTime<Utc>,\n) -> String {\n    if !enabled {\n        return \"disabled\".to_string();\n    }\n    match last_run {\n        None => \"ready (never run)\".to_string(),\n        Some(last) => {\n            let elapsed_hours = (now - last).num_hours().max(0) as u64;\n            if elapsed_hours >= cooldown_hours {\n                \"ready\".to_string()\n            } else {\n                let remaining = cooldown_hours - elapsed_hours;\n                format!(\"cooldown ({}h left)\", remaining)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build idle-strand cooldown rows for `needle status launched against. Weave, pulse, and unravel are keyed per workspace path.\n///\n/// Per-workspace vs per-worker gating:\n/// - reflect: workspace-level gate shared by all workers; cooldown_hours and\n///   min_beads_since_last both count against the same state file\n/// - weave/pulse/unravel: per-workspace state, so a fleet of workers on N\n///   workspaces maintains N independent cooldown windows per Reflect: single shared state file — show once for config.workspace.default.\n    {\n        let state_path = state_base.join(\"reflect\").join(\"reflect_state.json\");\n        let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&state_path)\n            .ok()\n            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<ReflectStateCli>(&s).ok())\n            .map(|s| s.last_consolidation);\n        let cooldown = config.strands.reflect.cooldown_hours;\n        rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n            strand: \"reflect\".to_string(),\n            workspace: config.workspace.default.display().to_string(),\n            enabled: config.strands.reflect.enabled,\n            last_run,\n            cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n            status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.reflect.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Weave, pulse, unravel: one row per workspace per strand.\n    for workspace in workspaces {\n        let hash = workspace_hash_cli(workspace);\n        let ws = workspace.display().to_string();\n\n        // Weave\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"weave\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = cooldown = config.strands.weave.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"weave\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: now),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Pulse\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"pulse\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                .ok()\n                .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<LastRunStateCli>(&s).ok())\n                .and_then(|s| s.last_run);\n            let cooldown = config.strands.pulse.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"pulse\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: config.strands.pulse.enabled,\n                last_run,\n                cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n                status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.pulse.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Unravel: per-bead cooldown — most recent analysis time as proxy for last run.\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"unravel\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                .ok()\n                .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<UnravelStateCli>(&s).ok())\n                .and_then(|s| s.analyzed.values().copied().max());\n            let cooldown = config.strands.unravel.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"unravel\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: config.strands.unravel.enabled,\n                last_run,\n                cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n                status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.unravel.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    rows\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// tmux session discovery\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A running tmux session belonging to needle.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]\nstruct TmuxSession {\n    name: String,\n    created: String,\n    status: String,\n    /// PID of the needle run process in this session (if available).\n    pid: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// List all tmux sessions whose names start with `needle-`.\nfn list_needle_sessions() -> Result<Vec<TmuxSession>> {\n    let output = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\n            \"list-sessions\",\n            \"-F\",\n            \"#{session_name}\\t#{session_created}\\t#{session_attached}\\t#{pane_pid}\",\n        ])\n        .output();\n\n    let output = match output {\n        Ok(o) => o,\n        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n            // tmux not installed — no sessions.\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            return Err(e).context(\"failed to run tmux list-sessions\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    // tmux exits non-zero when there are no sessions.\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        return Ok(vec![]);\n    }\n\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n    let sessions = stdout\n        .lines()\n        .filter_map(|line| {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('\\t').collect();\n            if parts.len() < 4 {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let name = parts[0];\n            if !name.starts_with(\"needle-\") {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let created = parts[1].to_string();\n            let attached = parts[2];\n            let status = if attached == \"1\" {\n                \"attached\".to_string()\n            } else {\n                \"detached\".to_string()\n            };\n            // Parse PID from pane_pid (tmux returns empty string if no pane)\n            let pid = parts[3].parse::<u32>().ok();\n            Some(TmuxSession {\n                name: name.to_string(),\n                created,\n                status,\n                pid,\n            })\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    Ok(sessions)\n}\n\n/// Return the set of worker IDs already running for a given agent.\n///\n/// Parses tmux session names matching `needle-{agent}-{worker_id}` It reads /proc to find processes whose\n/// command line contains \"needle run\" and extracts workspace, agent, and\n/// identifier from the arguments.\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn scan_needle_processes() -> Result<Vec<DiscoveredProcess>> {\n    use std::fs;\n\n    let mut discovered = Vec::new();\n\n    // Iterate over all entries in /proc.\n    let proc_dir = Path::new(\"/proc\");\n    let entries = match fs::read_dir(proc_dir) {\n        Ok(e) => e,\n        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n            // Not Linux — no process table available.\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            return Err(e).context(\"failed to read /proc directory\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    for entry in entries {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let pid_str = entry.file_name();\n        let pid: u32 = match pid_str.to_string_lossy().parse() {\n            Ok(p) => p,\n            Err(_) => continue, // Not a numeric directory (not a PID)\n        };\n\n        // Read the process's command line.\n        let cmdline_path = entry.path().join(\"cmdline\");\n        let cmdline_bytes = match fs::read(&cmdline_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue, // Process may have exited\n        };\n\n        // cmdline is null-separated; convert to space-separated for parsing.\n        let cmdline: String = cmdline_bytes\n            .split(|&b| b == 0)\n            .map(|args| String::from_utf8_lossy(args))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \");\n\n        // Check if this is a needle run process.\n        // The command line looks like: \"/path/to/needle run --workspace /path --count 1 ...\"\n        // Also handle NEEDLE_INNER=1 invocations: \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        // Also handle cases where the binary is called via symlink or absolute path.\n        //\n        // IMPORTANT: Exclude shell wrapper processes (bash -c \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 needle run ...\")\n        // We only want to discover the actual needle worker process, not the shell wrapper.\n        // The shell wrapper has a cmdline like: \"bash -c NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        if !cmdline.contains(\"needle run\")\n            && !cmdline.contains(\"needle-worker\")\n            && !cmdline.contains(\"NEEDLE_INNER\")\n        {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Filter out shell wrapper processes (bash -c \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 needle run ...\").\n        // These are created by tmux sessions and are not the actual needle worker processes.\n        // We only want to discover processes that are directly executing needle, not shell wrappers.\n        if cmdline.starts_with(\"bash -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"sh -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"/bin/bash -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"/bin/sh -c\")\n        {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Parse arguments to extract workspace, agent, identifier.\n        // Handle NEEDLE_INNER=1 prefix in cmdline: \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        let args: Vec<&str> = cmdline.split_whitespace().collect();\n        let mut workspace = None;\n        let mut agent = None;\n        let mut identifier = None;\n\n        let mut i = 0;\n        while i < args.len() {\n            match args[i] {\n                // Skip NEEDLE_INNER environment variable prefix\n                \"NEEDLE_INNER=1\" => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n                \"--workspace\" | \"-w\" => {\n                    if i + 1 < args.len() {\n                        workspace = Some(PathBuf::from(args[i + 1]));\n                        i += 2;\n                    } else {\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n                \"--agent\" | \"-a\" => {\n                    if i + 1 < args.len() {\n                        agent = Some(args[i + 1].to_string());\n                        i += 2;\n                    } else {\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n                \"--identifier\" | \"-i\" if i + 1 < args.len() => {\n                    identifier = Some(args[i + 1].to_string());\n                    i += 2;\n                }\n                \"--identifier\" | \"-i\" => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        discovered.push(DiscoveredProcess {\n            pid,\n            workspace,\n            agent,\n            identifier,\n            cmdline,\n        });\n    }\n\n    Ok(discovered)\n}\n\n/// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Simple shell \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n            crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(\"canary\".to_string())\n        });\n\n    let suite_id = runner.testing_binary().display().to_string();\n    tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::CanaryStarted {\n        suite: suite_id.clone(),\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"Running canary tests...\");\n    let report = runner.run()?;\n\n    tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::CanarySuiteCompleted {\n        suite: suite_id,\n        passed: report.passed as u32,\n        failed: (report.failed + report.timed_out + report.errors) as u32,\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"\\nCanary Report\");\n    println!(\"─────────────\");\n    println!(\"  Binary:   {}\", report.testing_binary.display());\n    println!(\"  Tests:    {}\", report.total_tests);\n    println!(\"  Passed:   {}\", report.passed);\n    println!(\"  Failed:   {}\", report.failed);\n    println!(\"  Timed out: {}\", report.timed_out);\n    println!(\"  Errors:   {}\", report.errors);\n    println!(\"  Duration: {}s\", report.duration_secs);\n    println!();\n\n    for result in &report.results {\n        let (icon, bead_id, detail) = match result {\n            crate::canary::CanaryTestResult::Passed { bead_id, .. } => {\n                (\"✓\", bead_id.as_str(), String::new())\n            }\n            crate::canary::CanaryTestResult::Failed {\n                bead_id, reason, ..\n            } => (\"✗\", bead_id.as_str(), format!(\" — {reason}\")),\n            crate::canary::CanaryTestResult::TimedOut {\n                bead_id,\n                elapsed_secs,\n            } => (\n                \"⏱\",\n                bead_id.as_str(),\n                format!(\" — timed out after {elapsed_secs}s\"),\n            ),\n            crate::canary::CanaryTestResult::Error { bead_id, message } => {\n                (\"!\", bead_id.as_str(), format!(\" — {message}\"))\n            }\n        };\n        println!(\"  {icon} {bead_id}{detail}\");\n    }\n\n    if report.can_promote() {\n        if config.self_modification.auto_promote {\n            println!(\"\\nAll tests passed — auto-promoting :testing to :stable...\");\n            // Capture hash before promote moves the file.\n            let hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(&report.testing_binary)\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n            runner.promote()?;\n            tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::CanaryPromoted { hash })?;\n            println!(\"Promotion complete. Fleet will hot-reload on next cycle.\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"\\nAll tests passed. Run `needle canary --status` to verify, then promote manually.\");\n            println!(\n                \"To promote: move needle-testing → needle-stable in {:?}\",\n                config.workspace.home.join(\"bin\")\n            );\n        }\n    } else {\n        let reason = format!(\n            \"{} failed, {} timed out, {} errors\",\n            report.failed, report.timed_out, report.errors\n        );\n        println!(\"\\nCanary tests FAILED. :testing will NOT be promoted.\");\n        runner.reject()?;\n        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::CanaryRejected { reason })?;\n        println!(\"Testing binary discarded.\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle upgrade` — check for and install updates.\nfn cmd_upgrade(check_only: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    if check_only {\n        let check = crate::upgrade::check_for_update()?;\n        if check.update_available {\n            println!(\n                \"Update available: {} → {}\",\n                check.current_version, check.latest_version\n            );\n            if let Some(notes) = &check.release_notes {\n                println!(\"\\nRelease notes:\\n{notes}\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Already up to date (version {})\", check.current_version);\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    crate::upgrade::perform_upgrade()?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle rollback` — restore the previous :stable binary.\nfn cmd_rollback() -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n\n    let runner = crate::canary::CanaryRunner::new(\n        config.workspace.home.clone(),\n        config.self_modification.canary_workspace.clone(),\n        config.self_modification.canary_timeout,\n    );\n\n    let status = runner.status()?;\n    if !status.prev_exists {\n        bail!(\"no previous :stable binary to rollback to\");\n    }\n\n    // Capture hashes before rollback.\n    let stable_hash = if status.stable_exists {\n        crate::upgrade::file_hash(&status.stable_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string())\n    } else {\n        \"none\".to_string()\n    };\n    let prev_hash =\n        crate::upgrade::file_hash(&status.prev_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n    println!(\"Rolling back to previous :stable...\");\n    runner.rollback()?;\n\n    // Emit rollback telemetry.\n    let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(\"rollback\".to_string(), &config.telemetry)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n            crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(\"rollback\".to_string())\n        });\n    tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::RollbackCompleted {\n        rolled_back_hash: stable_hash,\n        restored_hash: prev_hash,\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"Rollback complete. Fleet will hot-reload on next cycle.\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle reflect` — run learning consolidation on demand.\nfn cmd_reflect(workspace: Option<PathBuf>, force: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    let cli_overrides = crate::config::CliOverrides {\n        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let (config, _) = crate::config::ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n\n    let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(\"reflect\".to_string(), &config.telemetry)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n            crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(\"reflect\".to_string())\n        });\n\n    let state_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"reflect\");\n\n    // Create the extraction agent if configured.\n    let agent = if let Some(ref agent_cmd) = config.strands.reflect.extraction_agent {\n        Some(Box::new(crate::strand::reflect::CliReflectAgent::new(\n            agent_cmd.clone(),\n            config.strands.reflect.extraction_prompt_template.clone(),\n        )) as Box<dyn crate::strand::reflect::ReflectAgent>)\n    } else {\n        None\n    };\n\n    let strand = crate::strand::ReflectStrand::new(\n        config.strands.reflect.clone(),\n        workspace_root.clone(),\n        state_dir,\n        tel,\n        agent,\n    );\n\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    let summary = rt.block_on(strand.consolidate(force))?;\n\n    if summary.beads_processed == 0 && summary.learnings_added == 0 {\n        println!(\n            \"No consolidation performed (below threshold or on cooldown). Use --force to override.\"\n        );\n    } else {\n        println!(\n            \"Reflect complete: {} beads processed, {} learnings added, {} pruned, {} skills promoted\",\n            summary.beads_processed,\n            summary.learnings_added,\n            summary.learnings_pruned,\n            summary.skills_promoted,\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle update-rules` — download the latest gitleaks rules and update the\n/// vendored `config/gitleaks.toml`.\n///\n/// Downloads from upstream, validates by compiling all rules, and writes to\n/// the output path. Rebuild needle after running this to embed the new rules.\nfn cmd_update_rules(output: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::sanitize::{Sanitizer, GITLEAKS_UPSTREAM_URL};\n\n    let out_path = output.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\"config/gitleaks.toml\"));\n\n    println!(\"Fetching latest gitleaks rules from upstream...\");\n    println!(\"  URL: {GITLEAKS_UPSTREAM_URL}\");\n\n    let response = ureq::get(GITLEAKS_UPSTREAM_URL)\n        .call()\n        .context(\"failed to fetch gitleaks.toml from upstream\")?;\n\n    if response.status() >= 400 {\n        anyhow::bail!(\n            \"upstream returned HTTP {} when fetching gitleaks.toml\",\n            response.status()\n        );\n    }\n\n    let content = response\n        .into_string()\n        .context(\"failed to read upstream response body\")?;\n\n    // Validate by parsing and compiling all rules.\n    let sanitizer = Sanitizer::from_toml(&content, &[])\n        .context(\"downloaded gitleaks.toml failed validation\")?;\n\n    println!(\n        \"  Validated: {} rules compiled successfully.\",\n        sanitizer.rule_count()\n    );\n\n    // Create output directory if needed.\n    if let Some(parent) = out_path.parent() {\n        if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_context(|| {\n                format!(\"failed to create output directory: {}\", parent.display())\n            })?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::fs::write(&out_path, &content)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write {}\", out_path.display()))?;\n\n    println!(\n        \"  Written: {} ({} bytes)\",\n        out_path.display(),\n        content.len()\n    );\n    println!(\"Rebuild needle to embed the updated rules.\");\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// pick_available_names(occupied: &HashSet<String>, count: usize) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(count);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= count {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < count {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        Ok(ids)\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_no_sessions_running() {\n        let occupied = HashSet::new();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 3).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"alpha\", \"bravo\", \"charlie\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_skips_occupied() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = [\"alpha\", \"bravo\"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 2).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"charlie\", \"delta\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_skips_non_contiguous_occupied() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = [\"alpha\", \"charlie\", \"echo\"]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string())\n            .collect();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 3).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"bravo\", \"delta\", \"foxtrot\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_all_occupied_fails() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = NATO_ALPHABET.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let result = pick_available_names(&occupied, 1);\n        assert!(result.is_err());\n        let msg = result.unwrap_err().to_string();\n        assert!(msg.contains(\"26 occupied\"), \"got: {msg}\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_partial_exhaustion_fails() {\n        // Occupy 25 names, request 2 — only 1 available.\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = NATO_ALPHABET[..25].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let result = pick_available_names(&occupied, 2);\n        assert!(result.is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn identifier_collision_detected() {\n        let This produces two failure modes: session disruption (active worker crashes) or permanent hot-reload stall (new binary never loads, fixed by P11.1). Use `needle upgrade` for atomic updates instead.\n\nNEEDLE is a single binary with subcommands:","originalFile":"# NEEDLE Implementation Plan\n\n> **N**avigates **E**very **E**nqueued **D**eliverable, **L**ogs **E**ffort\n\n## Design Principles\n\nThese six principles are non-negotiable. Every design decision in this plan traces back to one or more of them.\n\n1. **Deterministic order.** Given the same queue state, every worker computes the same bead ordering. There is no randomness in selection. Ties are broken by creation time.\n\n2. **Explicit outcome paths.** Every possible result of every operation has a named handler. If an outcome can happen, it has a handler. If it doesn't have a handler, it cannot happen. The type system enforces exhaustiveness.\n\n3. **Platform and model agnostic.** NEEDLE wraps any headless CLI that accepts a prompt and exits. It runs on any POSIX system. It does not depend on any specific AI provider, model, or API.\n\n4. **Observable by default.** Every state transition, claim attempt, dispatch, and outcome emits structured telemetry. A silent worker is a broken worker. Telemetry is structured from origin (JSONL) and exportable as OpenTelemetry (OTLP) so any compliant backend — Tempo, Jaeger, Grafana, Honeycomb, Datadog, FABRIC — can consume NEEDLE's signals without a custom adapter.\n\n5. **Self-healing.** Workers detect and recover from stuck states, stale claims, crashed peers, and corrupted databases without human intervention. Recovery paths are explicit, not heuristic.\n\n6. **Separation of concerns.** The orchestrator does not execute work. The agent does not manage state. The bead store does not enforce workflow. Each component has one job.\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\nNEEDLE is composed of five layers:\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        CLI Layer                              │\n│  needle run | stop | list | attach | status | config          │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                     Worker Layer                              │\n│  Worker loop, strand waterfall, session management            │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                  Coordination Layer                            │\n│  Claiming, locking, heartbeats, peer awareness                │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                    Agent Layer                                 │\n│  Adapter interface, dispatch, result capture                  │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                   Foundation Layer                             │\n│  Telemetry, configuration, bead store interface, self-healing │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Component Map\n\n| Component | Responsibility | Inputs | Outputs |\n|-----------|---------------|--------|---------|\n| **CLI** | Parse commands, manage sessions | User commands | Worker processes |\n| **Worker** | Execute the strand waterfall loop | Bead queue state | Dispatch requests, state transitions |\n| **StrandRunner** | Evaluate strands in sequence | Queue state, config | Next bead or escalation |\n| **Claimer** | Atomic bead claiming with serialization | Candidate bead ID | Claimed bead or race-lost signal |\n| **PromptBuilder** | Construct deterministic prompts from bead context | Claimed bead | Prompt string |\n| **Dispatcher** | Load adapter, render template, execute agent | Prompt, adapter config | Agent process handle |\n| **OutcomeHandler** | Route exit code to explicit handler | Exit code, stdout/stderr | State transition |\n| **Telemetry** | Structured event emission | Any component event | JSONL records |\n| **HealthMonitor** | Heartbeat, stuck detection, peer awareness | Worker state | Recovery actions |\n| **ConfigLoader** | Hierarchical config resolution | Files, env, CLI args | Resolved config |\n| **BeadStore** | Abstract interface to bead backend | CRUD operations | Bead records |\n| **Mitosis** | Split multi-task beads into children with dedup | Failed bead, parent's existing children | Child beads or no-op |\n\n---\n\n## Language Decision\n\nThe implementation language must provide:\n\n| Requirement | Why | Source |\n|-------------|-----|--------|\n| Exhaustive pattern matching | Every outcome must be handled; compiler enforces it | Principle 2, bead-lifecycle-bugs.md |\n| Real module system | 45K single-file bash was unmaintainable | bash-at-scale-problems.md |\n| Structured error types | Silent failures caused cascading bugs | claim-race-conditions.md |\n| Native JSON support | Fragile jq parsing corrupted state | worker-starvation-lessons.md |\n| Proper concurrency primitives | flock/trap/PID files were inadequate | concurrency-approaches-compared.md |\n| Single binary distribution | NEEDLE must be trivially installable | Principle 3 |\n| Cross-platform | Linux, macOS at minimum | Principle 3 |\n| Static analysis | Catch undefined functions, unused variables at compile time | bundler-build-integrity.md |\n\n**Recommended: Rust.** Exhaustive `match`, `Result<T, E>` error handling, `serde_json`, `tokio` for async, single binary via static linking, cross-compilation. The beads ecosystem already has Rust precedent (beads_rust, beads-polis).\n\n**Acceptable alternative: Go.** Simpler learning curve, good concurrency, single binary. Lacks exhaustive matching (requires discipline instead of compiler enforcement).\n\n**Not acceptable: Bash, Python, Node.** Bash failed at scale (documented). Python/Node require runtime dependencies, violating single-binary distribution.\n\n---\n\n## Key Decisions from Research\n\nThese decisions are informed by the 14 research files in `docs/research/`:\n\n| Decision | Chosen Approach | Alternative Considered | Why |\n|----------|----------------|----------------------|-----|\n| Bead store interface | Abstract trait over `br` CLI | Direct SQLite access | Platform agnostic; works with future bead backends |\n| Claim atomicity | `br update --claim` + workspace flock | Central coordinator (Perles) | No SPOF; works with decentralized workers |\n| Heartbeat model | File-based heartbeat with TTL (from beads-polis) | Shared memory | Survives worker crashes; observable by peers |\n| Validation gates | Pluggable gate system (inspired by bg-gate) | Hardcoded checks | Different workspaces need different validation |\n| Work decomposition | Built-in mitosis with child-aware dedup | External only (spec2beads) | Mitosis is valid when the split criteria are semantic (multi-task detection) and dedup checks the parent's existing children |\n| Self-modification | Allowed with release channel promotion (testing → stable → fleet hot-reload) | Prohibited entirely | v1 failures came from untested changes deploying directly to the fleet. Canary testing with defined inputs/outputs prevents this. |\n| Workspace discovery | Explicit configuration | Filesystem scanning | Explore strand's unbounded find caused 35+ load |\n| Alert system | Verify-then-alert with rate limiting | Alert-on-empty | 100% false positive rate from naive alerting |\n\n## Key Decisions from Operational Learnings\n\nThese decisions are informed by the 9 notes files in `docs/notes/`:\n\n| Learning | Design Response |\n|----------|----------------|\n| Mitosis explosion (5,741 duplicate beads) | Mitosis checks parent's existing children before creating new ones. Duplicate splits are structurally impossible. Split criteria are semantic (multi-task detection), not numeric. |\n| 100% false positive starvation alerts | Three-state model: no beads exist / all claimed / invisible. Verify independently before alerting. |\n| Bundler shipped undefined functions | Compiled language eliminates this class entirely. |\n| Agent-owned closure most reliable | NEEDLE does not close beads. Agent receives `br close <id>` instruction in prompt. |\n| stdout/stderr corruption | Telemetry is a structured system, never interleaved with agent output. |\n| Workers modifying their own orchestrator | Self-modification allowed via release channels. New builds must pass canary tests in isolation before promotion to `:stable`. Fleet hot-reloads from `:stable`, never from `:testing`. |\n| ~20 worker practical limit (EX44) | Fleet sizing is bounded by three runtime factors: provider inference throughput, available CPU, and available RAM. NEEDLE monitors these and warns when saturated. Staggered launch is default. |\n| Bead granularity affects success rate | Document guidelines but don't enforce — this is a bead authoring concern, not orchestration. |\n\n---\n\n# State Machine\n\nThe worker loop is a finite state machine. Every state has defined entry conditions, actions, and exit transitions. There are no implicit states or fallthrough paths.\n\n## Worker States\n\n```\n                    ┌──────────┐\n                    │  BOOTING │\n                    └────┬─────┘\n                         │ config loaded, health check passed\n                         ▼\n                    ┌──────────┐\n              ┌────►│ SELECTING│◄──────────────────────────────┐\n              │     └────┬─────┘                                │\n              │          │ candidate found                      │\n              │          ▼                                      │\n              │     ┌──────────┐  race lost (retry < max)      │\n              │     │ CLAIMING │──────────────────────────┐    │\n              │     └────┬─────┘                           │    │\n              │          │ claimed                         │    │\n              │          ▼                                 ▼    │\n              │     ┌──────────┐                     ┌────────┐│\n              │     │ BUILDING │                     │RETRYING││\n              │     └────┬─────┘                     └────┬───┘│\n              │          │ prompt ready                   │     │\n              │          ▼                                └─────┘\n              │     ┌────────────┐\n              │     │DISPATCHING │\n              │     └────┬───────┘\n              │          │ agent process started\n              │          ▼\n              │     ┌──────────┐\n              │     │ EXECUTING│\n              │     └────┬─────┘\n              │          │ agent exited\n              │          ▼\n              │     ┌──────────┐\n              │     │ HANDLING │\n              │     └────┬─────┘\n              │          │ outcome processed\n              │          ▼\n              │     ┌──────────┐\n              │     │ LOGGING  │\n              │     └────┬─────┘\n              │          │ telemetry emitted\n              └──────────┘\n```\n\n### Terminal States\n\n```\n    ┌───────────┐       ┌───────────┐       ┌───────────┐\n    │ EXHAUSTED │       │  STOPPED  │       │  ERRORED  │\n    └───────────┘       └───────────┘       └───────────┘\n    all strands empty   graceful shutdown   unrecoverable\n```\n\n## State Definitions\n\n### BOOTING\n\n**Entry:** Worker process started.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Load configuration (global → workspace → CLI overrides)\n2. Validate bead store connectivity (`br doctor` or equivalent)\n3. Register in worker state registry\n4. Emit `worker.started` telemetry event\n5. Start heartbeat emitter\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Config loaded, bead store healthy | SELECTING |\n| Config invalid | ERRORED |\n| Bead store unreachable | ERRORED (after retry with backoff) |\n\n### SELECTING\n\n**Entry:** Worker is ready for next bead. This is the strand waterfall entry point.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Emit heartbeat\n2. Evaluate strands in sequence\n3. First strand that yields a candidate bead wins\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Candidate bead found | CLAIMING |\n| All strands exhausted | EXHAUSTED |\n| Shutdown signal received | STOPPED |\n\n### CLAIMING\n\n**Entry:** A candidate bead has been selected.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Acquire workspace claim lock (flock, per-workspace)\n2. Verify bead is still claimable (`br show --json`, check status + assignee)\n3. Attempt atomic claim: `br update <id> --claim --actor <worker-id>`\n4. Release workspace claim lock\n5. Emit `bead.claim.attempted` telemetry\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Exit Code | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|-----------|\n| Claim succeeded | 0 | BUILDING |\n| Race lost (already claimed) | 4 | RETRYING |\n| Bead no longer claimable (closed, deferred) | 1 | SELECTING |\n| Bead store error | >0 | SELECTING (after backoff) |\n| Max retries exceeded | — | SELECTING (exclude this bead, reset retry counter) |\n\n### RETRYING\n\n**Entry:** A claim attempt failed due to race condition.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Increment retry counter for this selection cycle\n2. Add failed bead ID to exclusion set\n3. Emit `bead.claim.race_lost` telemetry\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Retry count < max_retries (default: 5) | CLAIMING (with next candidate from same strand) |\n| Retry count >= max_retries | SELECTING (reset, move to next strand) |\n\n### BUILDING\n\n**Entry:** Bead is claimed by this worker.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Read full bead context: title, body, dependencies, labels, workspace path\n2. Read workspace context: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .beads/config.yaml\n3. Construct prompt from template (deterministic: same bead → same prompt)\n4. Include bead ID and `br close <id>` instruction in prompt\n5. Emit `prompt.built` telemetry (bead ID, prompt hash, token estimate)\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Prompt built successfully | DISPATCHING |\n| Bead context unreadable | HANDLING (outcome: failure, release bead) |\n\n### DISPATCHING\n\n**Entry:** Prompt is ready.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Load agent adapter configuration (YAML)\n2. Resolve invoke template with prompt, workspace path, environment\n3. Start agent process via rendered command\n4. Record process PID, start time\n5. Emit `agent.dispatched` telemetry (agent name, model, workspace)\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Agent process started | EXECUTING |\n| Agent binary not found | HANDLING (outcome: failure, release bead) |\n| Adapter config invalid | HANDLING (outcome: failure, release bead) |\n\n### EXECUTING\n\n**Entry:** Agent process is running.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Wait for agent process to exit\n2. Capture stdout, stderr, exit code\n3. Monitor execution timeout\n4. Continue emitting heartbeats while waiting\n5. Emit `agent.executing` heartbeat telemetry periodically\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Exit Code | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|-----------|\n| Agent exited normally | any | HANDLING |\n| Execution timeout exceeded | — | Kill process → HANDLING (outcome: timeout) |\n| Shutdown signal received | — | Kill process → HANDLING (outcome: interrupted) |\n\n### HANDLING\n\n**Entry:** Agent has exited (or was killed). This is where outcome routing happens.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Classify outcome by exit code\n2. Execute the handler for that outcome class\n3. Emit `bead.outcome` telemetry\n\n**Outcome Table:**\n\n| Outcome | Exit Code | Handler | Bead Action |\n|---------|-----------|---------|-------------|\n| **Success** | 0 | Verify bead was closed by agent. If not, log warning (do not auto-close). | None (agent owns closure) |\n| **Failure** | 1 | Evaluate for mitosis (see Mitosis section). If splittable, split and block parent. If not, release bead (`br update --status open --unassign`). Increment failure count via label. | Split or released |\n| **Timeout** | 124 | Release bead. Add `deferred` label. | Released + deferred |\n| **Crash** | >128 (signal) | Release bead. Create alert bead in workspace. | Released + alert |\n| **Race Lost** | 4 | (Handled at CLAIMING, should not reach here) | N/A |\n| **Interrupted** | — | Release bead. Clean shutdown. | Released |\n| **Agent Not Found** | 127 | Release bead. Emit error. Do not retry (config issue). | Released |\n| **Build Failure** | — | Release bead. Emit error. | Released |\n\n**Agent-owned closure:** NEEDLE does not close beads. The agent is instructed (via prompt) to run `br close <id>` upon successful completion. If the bead is still open after a success exit code, NEEDLE logs a warning but does not intervene. This is a deliberate design choice based on operational experience (see `docs/notes/bead-lifecycle-bugs.md`).\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Outcome processed | LOGGING |\n\n### LOGGING\n\n**Entry:** Outcome has been handled.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Record effort: elapsed time, exit code, token count (if extractable), estimated cost\n2. Emit `bead.completed` or `bead.released` telemetry\n3. Update worker state registry (beads processed, current streak)\n4. Reset retry counter and exclusion set\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Logging complete | SELECTING |\n\n### EXHAUSTED\n\n**Entry:** All strands returned no work.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Emit `worker.exhausted` telemetry\n2. If `idle_timeout` configured, start countdown\n3. If `idle_action` is `wait`, sleep with exponential backoff (max 60s)\n4. If `idle_action` is `exit`, terminate\n\n**Transitions:**\n| Condition | Next State |\n|-----------|-----------|\n| Backoff expired, retry strands | SELECTING |\n| Idle timeout exceeded | STOPPED |\n| Shutdown signal received | STOPPED |\n\n### STOPPED\n\n**Entry:** Graceful shutdown.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Release any claimed bead\n2. Deregister from worker state registry\n3. Stop heartbeat emitter\n4. Emit `worker.stopped` telemetry\n5. Exit process\n\n**Transitions:** None (terminal).\n\n### ERRORED\n\n**Entry:** Unrecoverable error.\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Release any claimed bead (best-effort)\n2. Emit `worker.errored` telemetry with error details\n3. Deregister from worker state registry (best-effort)\n4. Exit process with non-zero code\n\n**Transitions:** None (terminal).\n\n## Error Model\n\nErrors are classified into three tiers:\n\n### Tier 1: Transient (retry)\n\nTemporary failures that resolve on their own. The worker retries with backoff.\n\n- Bead store temporarily unreachable\n- Claim race lost\n- Lock contention timeout\n- Agent timeout (may succeed on re-dispatch)\n\n### Tier 2: Bead-scoped (release and continue)\n\nFailures specific to one bead. Release it and move on.\n\n- Agent exited with failure\n- Prompt build failed (bead context unreadable)\n- Agent binary missing\n\n### Tier 3: Worker-scoped (exit)\n\nFailures that affect the worker's ability to function. Exit and let the fleet manager handle it.\n\n- Configuration invalid\n- Bead store persistently unreachable\n- Filesystem full\n- Heartbeat file unwritable\n\n## Invariants\n\nThese must hold at all times. Violation of any invariant is a bug.\n\n1. **A worker holds at most one claimed bead.** There is no pipelining or parallel execution within a single worker.\n\n2. **A claimed bead is always released.** Every path through HANDLING releases the bead unless the agent closed it. There is no path where a bead remains claimed after the worker moves to SELECTING.\n\n3. **Heartbeat is continuous.** From BOOTING to STOPPED/ERRORED, the worker emits heartbeats. A gap in heartbeats means the worker is stuck or dead.\n\n4. **Telemetry is emitted for every state transition.** Silent transitions do not exist.\n\n5. **The exclusion set is bounded.** It is cleared on every transition to SELECTING. It cannot grow unboundedly within a selection cycle because max_retries is finite.\n\n6. **Shutdown is always graceful when possible.** SIGTERM triggers STOPPED, not ERRORED. Only SIGKILL causes ungraceful termination, and heartbeat TTL handles that case.\n\n---\n\n# Architecture\n\n## Module Boundaries\n\nNEEDLE is organized into crates (Rust) or packages (Go) with strict dependency rules. No circular dependencies. Each module has a single responsibility.\n\n```\nneedle (binary)\n├── cli/              CLI parsing, session management\n├── worker/           Worker loop, state machine\n├── strand/           Strand waterfall evaluation\n│   ├── pluck.rs      Primary bead selection\n│   ├── mend.rs       Stale claim cleanup, dependency repair\n│   ├── explore.rs    Multi-workspace discovery\n│   ├── weave.rs      Gap analysis, bead creation\n│   ├── unravel.rs    Alternative proposals for HUMAN beads\n│   ├── pulse.rs      Codebase health scans\n│   ├── reflect.rs    Learning consolidation\n│   ├── splice.rs     Worker failure documentation\n│   └── knot.rs       Exhaustion alerting\n├── claim/            Atomic claiming, lock management\n├── prompt/           Prompt construction from bead context\n├── dispatch/         Agent adapter loading, process execution\n├── outcome/          Exit code classification, outcome handlers\n├── commit_hook.rs    Bead-Id trailer injection for git commits\n├── telemetry/        Structured event emission, sinks\n│   └── otlp.rs       OpenTelemetry exporter\n├── health/           Heartbeat, stuck detection, peer monitoring\n├── config/           Hierarchical configuration loading\n├── bead_store/       Abstract bead backend interface\n├── types/            Shared types, error definitions\n├── learning/         Retrospective extraction, learnings management\n├── skill/            Skill library, retrieval, promotion\n├── trace/            Trace capture, storage, retention\n├── transcript/       Session JSONL parsing, action-outcome extraction\n├── drift/            Session similarity, clustering, divergence detection\n├── decision/         Decision point detection, ADR management\n├── placement/        CLAUDE.md lowest-common-ancestor resolution\n├── stats/            Aggregation engine, A/B comparison\n├── supervisor/       Fleet supervisor daemon (auto-scale)\n├── canary/           Release channel
